PASSED HORS D’OEUVRES
7:00PM - 8:00PM | ASTOR HALL
Crispy potato tot, creme fraiche, caviar GF, NF
Requires oven.
Heat the potato tot. Place a dot of crème fraiche on top of the warm potato tot. Garnish with caviar (1g ea.) & a chive baton. Make sure all the chive batons are in the same direction when you plate the HD on the tray.
Spicy tuna tartare, crispy rice cake, furikake GF, DF, NF
Requires oven, refrigeration.
Mix Tuna with dressing, add salt if necessary and keep very cold. Heat rice cake until warm, top with 1.5tsp of tuna and top with one piece of scallion.
Peking duck, moo shu tuile DF, NF
Requires oven. Requires taco tray or smaller taco insert.
Warm duck. Mix cucumber and scallion with chiffonade mint and chiffonade cilantro. Place in bottom of tuile. Tiny squeeze of hoisin. Duck on top. Taste one for balance.
Seared rare wagyu ‘lollipop’ with fleur de sel on pronged skewers GF, DF, NF
Requires oven, pack square shot glass for skewers, and wagyu skewers.
Hot, rare, cut at a slight angle about ¼” thick, fleur de sel, glass or bowl for used skewers
Artichoke panisse, artichoke mustard, black truffle carpaccio & thyme VEGAN, GF, DF, NF
Requires oven
Heat the artichoke panisse, pipe a hefty dot of artichoke mustard in the center, place a mound of chopped truffle carpaccio on top and garnish with some thyme leaves.
Truffled grilled cheese sandwich with celery relish V, NF
Requires oven.
Heat until cheese melts, blot as needed; garnish with small dollop of celery relish.
PLACED
Smoked paprika potato chips VEGAN, DF, GF, NF

1 cup per person
BARTOS FORUM

PASSED SMALL PLATES
Miso glazed black cod with snow pea salad NF, GF, DF
Elite White Square B&B, 5.25
Dress snow peas with snow pea dressing. Heat black cod. Plate cod and drizzle with miso vinaigrette. Top with thin 'bed' of dressed snow peas and top with microgreens and lucky sorrel.
Braised short ribs with celery root puree
Tasting ceramic oval bowl 4 x 3.25
Heat short ribs in sauce; mound in oval bowl on top of celery root puree; plate with shredded brussels sprouts. Garnish with memo chive and confetti flowers.
Butternut squash risotto with roasted porcini
Pack microplane, rondeau, pot.
New from Shane
Heat risotto using veg stock as needed. Add in butternut squash puree, butter, mascarpone, and parmesan. Add roasted butternut squash and garnish with salad sensations.

STEAK “FRITE” KIOSK
Chefs building cones of grilled steak and pommes pailles
PROTEIN
Hanger
Cook to MR. Rest, slice very thin on station.
SAUCES (to be drizzled in cone)
Bearnaise
Warm, mix in a little xanthan gum to help hold, thin with a little water if needed. Hold in sauce warmer.
Au poivre
Warm, hold in sauce warmer.
Bordelaise
Warm, hold in sauce warmer.
INCLUDES
Pommes pailles ‘Frites’, dressed with truffle essence or parmesan
Roughly chop parsley. Toss frites with toppings by request: truffle shavings, truffle oil, grated parm, and parsley. Served in parchment-lined julep cups.
DINNER STATION
PROTEINS
Seared Halibut, lemon butter sauce
Finish cooking fish. Make lemon beurre blanc. Add to platter and finish fish with generous drizzle of sauce and lemon zest. Garnish with flowering herb sampler.
Lamb chops
Brush the rack of lamb with sauce and finish in the oven. Shingle chops on platter and garnish with rosemary.
SIDES
Baby greens, fall vegetables, herb dressing
Make salad with mixed greens, bias-cut carrots, cauliflower and butternut squash dressed in herb dressing.
Crispy smashed potatoes
Reheat until crispy.
Charred broccoli, EVOO, chili
Reheat broccoli – dress in lemon vinaigrette and top with chili flakes. Garnish platter with lemon wheels.
PASTA – CHEF ACTIVATED
Spicy rigatoni vodka
Pack pot, microplane.
Pick up vodka sauce with butter, water and chili flakes. Mix rigatoni into the vodka sauce. Sending marinara for vegan option. On station: toss pasta in sauté pans, using water/butter to loosen as needed. Serve with parmesan.
VEGAN OPTION
Pasta with marinara
PASSED SWEETS
Lemon Ice box cake, (NF)
Requires freezer. Pack whipped cream canister & charges.
Whip cream with powdered sugar using iSi cannister. Temper ice box cake to serve, chilled not frozen. Finish with a dot of lemon gel on one end, and a dot of whipped cream on the other end.

Pack ISI canister or kitchen aid
Whip cream. Pipe whip cream into center of meringue. Then pipe a Hersey kiss of chestnut cream to cover.
Five-layer chocolate cake
